quest.title: Danger All Around
quest.description: In order to escape from underground, the party keeps searching for a way out after getting some rest...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1125, Mora x49200, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x9

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After what feels like a long time has passed, everyone's concept of time has become hazy. No one can tell exactly how long they've been trapped...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, there's nothing for Paimon to do here. So boring...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, how Paimon longs to stretch her legs and run free in the world outside again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean, fly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, alright "fly free" then! Basically, Paimon just wants out of here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just like that, a whole day has gone by...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just a day? No, it feels like we've been down here for months.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe not months, but at least like 20 days, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yo yo, thought I heard you chatting over here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, hey Bull-Chucker.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well everyone, I just completed another survey of the surrounding area, still nothing has changed today.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Here, have some water and take a rest.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Thank you, Shinobu. It's easy to forget to keep hydrated down here.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Argh! Out! I want out! All I want is to cruise the streets and have beetle fights again!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Boss, remember there's your image to consider.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But it's so boring, walking around this hole every day! If only I could slurp some ramen and see the beautiful flowers again...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Ramen? Wait a minute...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Speaking of ramen, Traveler, are you hungry?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not really.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I'm not hungry either... But let me pose the question this way: Who is the biggest eater among us?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It's definitely not me.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, what's everybody looking at me for? It's definitely not me, if anyone it's this one right here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wh—What are you looking at Paimon for?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Paimon, are you hungry?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, no, Paimon's not hungry. Why do you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Hmm, if that's the case...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? Wh—What am I missing here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon said she feels like it's been at least 20 days.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yes, I heard that too, as I was walking over. The question is, how can you not feel hungry... even after 20 days?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And I feel like it's only been about one day.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: That's also strange. Of course, everyone has different perceptions of the passage of time... but how could one person feel like it's only been 1 day and someone else 20 days?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yeah, now that you mention it, I feel like we've been here three, four, five days, but I don't feel hungry or thirsty at all.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Although I cooked some food, it wasn't because I was hungry, I just wanted to keep our spirits up. I was planning on saving our rations so we could survive a few more days, but I haven't really felt hungry since.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, not only am I not hungry, but I don't feel any real signs of fatigue either... Whether I sleep or not doesn't seem to have any effect on how I feel.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yes, I concur. Resting doesn't make me feel more refreshed, and staying awake doesn't make me any more tired. Very peculiar... It's almost as if our physical state has been suspended.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, the more you say, the scarier it sounds... Paimon doesn't even want to think about it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I wonder if Xiao is experiencing the same phenomenon...?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? What's wrong, Traveler? Did you think of something?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell everyone that you were unable to summon Xiao...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: That's pretty weird... Sounds like the little dude must be in danger.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: But he is an adeptus, this kind of situation should be no trouble for him. I fear that this problem underground is bigger than we thought.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I found something, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I just discovered a new path over there that seems to lead to an unknown area.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You mean a way out? Oh, finally!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! You found something! Ooh, please, please be the exit!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I still suspect things can't be that simple. We should all stay prepared for whatever comes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon doesn't see anything out of the ordinary here...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Appearances can be deceiving. As I was examining the wall just now, I noticed there was something unusual about this stone.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Seems to me that it's been created using some illusory magic... Hidden behind it lies a passageway.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, so there really is a path behind here!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Gotta hand it to ya, that sure wasn't easy to find, but at least we can finally get outta here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, thanks to Yelan.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Ms. Yelan's determination and eye for detail are certainly impressive... not to mention, you've hardly had any rest the whole time we've been trapped here.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter. I'm not tired.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well, given we're all already here, we might as well go in and explore.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right behind ya! Paimon can't wait to get out of this place!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, Ushi, looks like our little Lavender Melon has fallen asleep, huh? Do ya think she's dreaming?

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo? Moo.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Man, she looks wiped out. It's kinda hard to see her like this, I mean, most of the time she never shuts up... Ah, poor thing.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: And that little dude looks done in, too. Ah, I'm kinda worried about 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo, moo, moo.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I sleep like this when I'm in jail? Hah! Good one. I do slumber like a king.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}!? When did you get here?

talks.objective: Confirm the situation inside the Domain
Go to the breach on the platform

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The ground... has dissolved? What's down there...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Is that little dude called Xiao down there? We gotta help him!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hold on! Something's not right here.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...What's this...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It appears to be a small fissure...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: What can you possibly find inside? It can't be a living person, can it, hahaha... Whoa!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Conqueror of Demons!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Xiao? Is that you?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Quit tryin' to scare us, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, is this some kind of illusion? Paimon can't touch him...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Conqueror of Demons, can you hear us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened? Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hello? Little dude! Anyone home?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He isn't responding... What's going on here?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, he finally said something!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We followed your voice and found you here. But it's kinda strange, we can't touch you... How did you become an illusion?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: An illusion...?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Talk about a coincidence. We were just thinking you went missing and stuff, and then we heard the sound of you fighting. Pretty lucky we found you if you ask me, haha. You didn't get hurt, did ya?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: A coincidence? Wait...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Something's not right... *cough* Something's wrong with this domain... Leave, now! Get out of there!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a minute... Xiao, are you hurt?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If we can, we should have him regroup with us as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Tell us what happened and where you are now. We'll come find you immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: No, your safety is the top priority. It seems this space can...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Huh? He disappeared...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where'd he go? It sounded like he might be injured. We need to go help him!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It seems the only option we have to explore any further is through that entrance over there.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Heh, he's injured and telling US to be careful? It's not like we're in any danger here.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Anyway, the secret behind whatever's going on should be in this cave, right? Don't worry, little dude, Itto's on the way!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Boss, please don't go charging ahead, you're an oni, not some hunting dog.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm invincible. Ahhh! My butt!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...Looks pretty deep. Be careful, everyone.

talks.objective: Examine the mysterious door in front of you

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Bull-Chucker, how's your rear?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: It's fine... my butt is tough...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Go ahead, you can cry if it hurts. I promise I'll try not to laugh.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: What! What do you mean, try not to laugh!? You should be feeling some serious sympathy for me right now!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: But wouldn't feeling sorry for you be a violation of your dignity? Besides, it's harder not to laugh when I'm not the one in pain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pff... hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Paimon, don't laugh... Pfft...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It's okay, everybody. If you want to laugh at him, just let it out.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Don't you have a heart, Shinobu? Huh, and people think I'M the monster...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Wait a second...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Xiao is not here, but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is that a door?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems a little out of place here, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Maybe it's some sort of... I dunno, an emergency shelter? There was a picture book I read once that said nice people sometimes build cabins in dangerous places, so that anyone in trouble can take shelter inside.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Our little dude must be inside then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I wouldn't be too sure about that. Any person with a normal sense of danger wouldn't be so optimistic.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Bull-Chucker, looks like your subordinate is telling you what's what.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, I believe she was talking to both of us, yeah, so you can wipe that smug smile off your face!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Aight, watch and learn, Shinobu. This is why I'm the boss and you're the deputy. If no one is macho enough to open the door, then allow me.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Step aside.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Once this door's open, we are outta here!

dialogues.speaker: Reiichi
dialogues.text: Evil oni, begone... You heard me, get out of here!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Waaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Uh, am I seeing things, or was there someone behind the door?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Nah! Can't be. You're just seeing things!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we just open the door again and see?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Who? Uh, me?... Oh, a—alrighty, I'll open it again!

dialogues.speaker: Reiichi
dialogues.text: All you do is goof around all day. You're a bad influence to our child... begone...!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Aaaaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Those people are carrying bowls... bowls full of beans. What's that all about?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: People throw beans to drive out oni. Boss is an oni, so they throw beans at him to get rid of him.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Gave me the fright of my life... What are people from Inazuma doing in a place like this anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Calm down, now, you're a person from Inazuma too you know...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, let's get one thing straight, alright? I'm not a person, I'm an oni!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Right, but that's not the point. The question is, does this door lead to Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How could that be possible? Ugh, this place is so weird. Paimon's starting to think it really is haunted!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Open the door again and see if anything changes.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You guys go right ahead, I'm not opening it again. So, who's up? Oh, how about Paimon? Why don't you open it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: N—No way! Somebody else do it, Paimon's scared...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll try.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: That's our Shinobu! Now, don't let whoever's behind that door push you around, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Alright, let's see what's behind the door this time.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Woman's Voice
dialogues.text: Still reading, Shinobu? Listen, young lady, you should keep your nose out of those books and start taking my advice... I've already found you a perfectly good job as a shrine maiden at the Grand Narukami Shrine. You'll be far better off there than...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Shinobu? Who was that?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: No way, was that who I think it was?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Well, this is embarrassing. That voice was my mother...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: This is one place I wasn't counting on having to hear that speech again...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Your mother wanted you to become a shrine maiden?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: The whole reason I came to study in Liyue was because I didn't want to become a shrine maiden. My family never approved of my studies, so they wanted me to work in the Grand Narukami Shrine after I returned to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: From what we know about Lady Guuji, it seems being a shrine maiden is a pretty cushy job.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Think of it this way: Some cats can be domesticated and kept in the house, while other cats are meant to survive in the wild... As for me, I need complete freedom and space. Although I do admit that being a shrine maiden is a decent job, it's just not for me.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: That's right, your calling is with the gang. I mean, just look at you. You rock. You're totally hardcore. C'mon, am I the only one with chills right now?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It's true. You've got a good thing going. What's most important is that you enjoy what you do.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Gotta agree with you there.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: From the look of it, what's behind the door can change, and not only that, it always changes to something that nobody wants to see. So uh, how are we gonna get through that?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: And don't forget, we have that little dude waiting for us to save him. We need to get our rear in gear.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Would any of you like to give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No thanks. I'd prefer not to open it if only something terrible awaits. If anyone's going to find a way through, it's not going to be me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, why?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Because I don't buy it, that's why. I don't believe for one second that we're gonna find the Conqueror of Demons by going through that door, so I'm sure as heck not gonna be the one to get us through.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Not gonna lie, you don't sound like you have much of an imagination.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll try.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yeah! My savior, show 'em what you're made of!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any phobias, Yanfei?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I'm sure I probably do... But nothing springs to mind right now.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Anyway, I suppose I'll find out once I open the door.

dialogues.speaker: Ruyi
dialogues.text: You old geezer! Out of eight pounds of salt, today you gave away three for free, sold two, and exchanged three for booze. How much money did you actually make in the end?

dialogues.speaker: Guangzhu
dialogues.text: Huh? But didn't you tell me to sell things as I pleased? Why can't I give the customers something for free?

dialogues.speaker: Ruyi
dialogues.text: You fool! You told the old man next door to come and fetch the salt. Well, he broke his leg on the way over, and now his son is asking for compensation! Seriously, *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Huh, a civil dispute... Didn't see that coming.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who were they?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: No one in particular, but it is a prime example of the many difficult civil cases that I've had trouble handling before.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmm, so you mean you don't like handling disputes over petty matters?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Not exactly, what I mean is that I don't like working with people who cannot let go of trivial grievances, especially of the kind you saw just now. They start with good intentions, but end up making a big fuss...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It's not long before those good intentions plunge into injury and accidents. *sigh* It's always a shame...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It's my desire to solve problems for people, that's why I became a legal adviser. It just seems that I still can't fully comprehend the complicated minds of some people.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I understand what you mean... The human mind is probably both the most complicated and tragic of things.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I suppose there's no need to discuss this any further. Does anyone else wanna try the door?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Don't look at me, I told you I'm not taking a chance with that thing.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: C'mon, Yelan! We're a team here. If you're not gonna try, then at least give us a convincing reason why.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: In that case, then let me be perfectly clear.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I serve Ningguang, the Tianquan of the Qixing. The scope of my work includes some of Liyue's biggest secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The chances are, if I open this door, there can be no witnesses left alive. Is that a sufficient reason for you?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, uh y—yeah... s—sounds impressive... Um, hey... Shinobu, who's Ningguang?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: She's someone who won't let you walk out of The Chasm alive if she finds out that you're prying into her secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Boss, you really do need to work on learning who's who in the world these days.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Look, I know what I need to know, it's called being a free oni!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, now Paimon gets it... Yelan works for Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Haha, yes, which is precisely why I was trying to keep her secret. We should avoid letting Yelan open this door.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: What about you, Traveler? Would you like to try?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, go for it, Traveler. Besides, you never know who could be behind that door. Maybe it could even be Xiao!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I say give it a shot. Who knows? Maybe little dude is waiting for us on the other side.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Hmm, maybe... I'm always looking for someone...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, wait... What's Paimon looking at?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Is this... the Abyss!?)

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: The voice is much clearer now. We're close.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a spatial rift!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #Conqueror of Demons, can you hear me? It's Yanfei. {NICKNAME} and I are trying to find you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xiao, are you there?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Traveler? Yanfei?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It worked!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I'm fine.

choices.text: We heard the sound of you fighting...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Listen to me, it's chaotic here. We may not be in the same space, but sometimes the sound can get through, which means these separate spaces intersect from time to time.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Everything is chaotic here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Find a way to get to us.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: No.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The darkness that sullies my soul is harmful to mortals.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Right now, we have more dangerous things to worry about than that. This space is using our urge to find you to lure us into traps.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Without you here with us, our search for you could very well lead us into danger.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Please come.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: So you're in danger, too?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Uh-oh, he said "too"...)

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...There was no need for you to search for me.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: #But we're worried about you. And earlier, {NICKNAME} was tricked into entering a dangerous place...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's true.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: How do we meet?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Conqueror of Demons, can you find out where our voices are coming from? Find the spot where our voices are the clearest and try something there, it might work.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...I see. The spaces may intersect amidst the chaos...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...By "try something"... Do you mean...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Hurry! If we miss this chance, we might not get another one!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Xiao?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Stand back.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Phew... Hmm.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Oh no... he looks badly injured.)

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Let's get him back to the camp!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Now, we can avoid getting split up.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Oh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: A lot's happened here. But this wasn't just for our own safety. You're injured, we can't just leave you alone.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It's just a flesh wound. I am fine. I shouldn't let myself be a burden to you.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: You're not a burden. Don't think that for one second. We need you, all of us. For our sake, please, stay here. Please?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Fine... As you wish.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You're injured. Get some rest. Everything else can wait.

choices.text: Yes, wait until you get better.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Alright.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Xiao has closed his eyes and seems to be resting... Could he be dreaming? This is quite astonishing.)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Is a yaksha who never lowers his guard capable of having dreams?)

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmm... As expected, something strange is going on here.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Oh, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You're both here. Great, I want to talk to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's all talk. We'll put our heads together.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You, Yelan, and Yanfei share all the information you have with each other...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I also felt that the space was targeting us, but Yanfei managed to exploit its weakness. Leave it to Yanfei to find a loophole.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Based on what just happened, we can now confirm our suspicions that space and time function chaotically here. In addition, we must stay vigilant to avoid the traps set for us by this place.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Now that we've found the Conqueror of Demons, the next thing we need to do is find a way out.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I went back to the domain again just now. Although I couldn't find a new route, it wasn't a completely fruitless trip.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: My clan has practiced magic for generations and has created some catalysts that only we know how to use.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I recognized something like one of these catalysts in the domain. Unfortunately, it disappeared as soon as I approached it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Was it an illusion?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I think so. But it's hard to distinguish between reality and illusion here. I can't be sure.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Also... I am the only one out of all of us who could know what it would look like. To me, that confirms that this place really is reading our minds.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Just like with that door. It's like it's alive, and testing us.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: By reading our minds and showing us what we want, it creates the reality that we want to be true... Everything it does is either to get us to lower our guard or to wear us down.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If that's the case, it can only have one goal: To trap us here until we die. What else could it be?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...We should prepare for the worst, but we mustn't give up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Agreed.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I've always known there were secrets hidden in The Chasm. But even the Qixing have never heard about anything like this.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Yelan, when we first ran into you, you said you had something to do. What were you referring to?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I was looking for the truth behind the monster invasion from Khaenri'ah.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...Khaenri'ah!?)

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Please keep everything I'm about to say to yourselves. No one else can know. Otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: We got it.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: 500 years ago, a wave of dark beasts from Khaenri'ah attacked the seven nations of Teyvat. Naturally, Liyue was also affected.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Under Rex Lapis's command, the Millelith fought hard to hold the frontline near The Chasm. But these were vicious beasts, and this was the most desperate battle Liyue had ever faced.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: At a critical moment, someone distracted the monsters and led them away. Just when all hope seemed lost, the tide turned.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The Liyue army eventually won the war, but there were many who never returned.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Two of my ancestors took part in that war, and the one who made it back went insane... Everything about it was strange.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The current generation of Qixing knows very little about these events, and very few came back from The Chasm alive. Finding out the truth has been a waiting game.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The day The Chasm was unsealed, I put in a request to be transferred here so I could finally learn the truth of what happened back then.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: But this place we've ended up in, and the possibilities we are facing... it's all far more terrifying than I'd imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: ...We can't give up. Right now, our number one priority has to be getting out of here alive.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The Chasm, Khaenri'ah... What happened 500 years ago?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (And what did Xiao see back in that other space? Who was he fighting against?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Can we really get out of here in one piece?)

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You don't look well. I guess things still haven't improved.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It's okay, you don't have to go into all the details.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I really envy the boss.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey! There you are, {NICKNAME}! Whew, you sure had Paimon scared!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We couldn't open the door after you went in! Everyone was super worried about you. Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Did you find anything, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So? Did you find the person we want to rescue inside?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Judging by the look on your face, I'm guessing you saw something a little unpleasant in there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, I did.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Behind the door, I saw...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The darkness of the Abyss that took my twin away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How could that be?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Aww, don't worry. Paimon will keep searching for {F#him}{M#her} with you. Cheer up!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ugh, stupid door! I'll smash you to pieces!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If Paimon wasn't feeling so exhausted, she'd help out, too... *yawn*...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, what is this, nap time?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: So, let me get this straight, not only did we not find Xiao through that door, we saw all the things that we wish to avoid.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'm starting to have a very ominous feeling about this domain. It's constantly changing, and its changes seem to be targeted at us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I feel the same way. We need to watch our every step, there is definitely more to this place than meets the eye.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I concur. We came here following the Conqueror of Demons, but we ended up only finding a strange door.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: The things we've encountered on the other side of that door are equally strange. It shows us whatever we fear the most. We are in a space that defies common logic.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: On top of that, I'm starting to feel tired after that experience. But I thought we'd established that getting tired doesn't happen down here...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The phenomenon hasn't reached a lethal stage just yet, otherwise, we would have starved to death without eating for so long.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I'm starting to worry that we're being affected by the changes in this space. In order to avoid the sudden accumulation of hunger and fatigue, we should eat and rest regularly from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, that makes sense.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Paimon suddenly feels exhausted. It's really tiring going through all this...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, I'm starting to feel tired too... No, no, NO! It's all just an illusion! I will not let my mind play tricks on me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Paimon's whole body just feels so heavy now...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hmm, according to the current evidence, it seems our physical condition was suspended in this space before, which granted us immunity to the effects of fatigue and hunger.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: But now it seems that mental fatigue is unavoidable...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Though we have yet to locate the Conqueror of Demons, I suggest we go back and get some rest. It'll be difficult to rescue anyone if we're on the verge of collapse ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: She's right. Hey, Lavender Melon, you okay? Want me to carry you?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a persistent search, you find a shortcut that takes you back to the entrance. You then return to the camp for a rest...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It's hard to believe what we've encountered...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Well, I suppose there's no use hiding it anymore now that everyone's seen it. What you all saw really was my biggest fear. I never want to become a shrine maiden... Who could tolerate such a boring life!?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: After these last few years with the Arataki Gang, I suppose you could say I've seen it all. It's taken every skill in my arsenal to constantly clean up the messes they make.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Though the list of annoying things to deal with is practically endless, I am totally free in the Arataki Gang.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Strolling around the streets, roasting Lavender Melons with friends in the open country... I know it sounds pretty silly, but that's the life that I want.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Just don't laugh at me, okay? Otherwise, you might find yourself on the receiving end of a good beating.

choices.text: What do we do from here...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: You don't look very well, at least not like when we just arrived. Are you troubled by what you saw behind the door?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Listen to me, the most important thing is always the choices you have in front of you.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Get some rest before you gather the courage to take your next step.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Once you've chosen the path to take, don't hesitate. You must believe in your decision.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Alright, you should get some rest too.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ushi, you sure you can't find a way back to that door again?

dialogues.speaker: Ushi
dialogues.text: Moo...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, perfect timing! I was just having a chat with Ushi about that!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You know what? I can handle those mean people behind the door throwing beans at me. But causing trouble for you? Nah-uh, that ain't gonna fly with this guy!

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: What? There's nothing we can do? Listen here, Beefcake, you shouldn't give up so easily.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Can't you have one last look for it? If you really can't find it, we'll just have to find another door. With any luck, one that connects to the outside world. You feel me?

choices.text: What do we do from here...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Yup, that's the big question.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Gotta be honest, I have no idea.

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo... Moo!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Oh c'mon! Don't get mad at me, I'm just being real here.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I did think about just using my oni super strength to dig our way out, but the rocks here are even tougher than prison walls...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The rocks didn't even budge when Ushi charged 'em. It's pretty obvious this place is meant to keep us in here.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The only thing I can do now is... well, take care of this exhausted little Lavender Melon.

response.speaker: Ushi
response.text: Moo, moo! Moo.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Yeah, I know... You're helping too, Ushi.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Sure, you do you. Just remember, even if the sky comes crashing down, I'll prop it up with my own two hands! And don't worry, I'll take care of the little Lavender Melon.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You haven't slept at all, are you sure you're okay? This place seems even more perilous than we first thought.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me. Staying focused under pressure for as long as it takes is my specialty.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Now, if I'm not mistaken, looks like you've got some new ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Hehe, how could you tell?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It's my job to keep tabs on people.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I figured as much. They're just preliminary ideas at this point, but I haven't completely thought them through yet. I'll tell you more once my ideas have taken shape.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Sure, sounds good.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I also have some ideas of my own. I'll fill you in after I've confirmed some things.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like a productive conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hehe, you think so?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: As they say, two heads are always better than one.

talks.objective: Head to the place Yanfei mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #Thanks for coming to speak with me, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I've been thinking about this place... Since we still don't know just what kind of danger we're up against, we can't afford to delay any longer. We have to find the Conqueror of Demons as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's just what I was thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Don't you think it's a strange coincidence that as soon as you told us about the Conqueror of Demons, we heard his voice in that place?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It almost seems deliberate... As if something was trying to convince us that the Conqueror of Demons was there in order to lure us into the unknown.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I have a theory, but I can't tell the others just yet... I don't want anyone to panic.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Judging from the Conqueror of Demons' reactions, I think that he was somewhere else, but his voice and image were projected to our location.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: ...Is it possible that we've entered into a chaotic space?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Chaotic? What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: We're seeing things and people that shouldn't be here... even ghosts.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: And we don't feel hungry because the state of our bodies is suspended. It's as if... time itself has stopped for us.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If that's true, it means we've entered into a place where normal logic doesn't apply...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: When you put it all together, everything points towards one possibility.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: This is a place where time and space are thrown into chaos.

choices.text: So, when we saw him at the domain entrance...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: And yet — if it's truly chaotic, how did we find our friend's voice even when we had no idea where he was? It doesn't make any sense...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Unless this space wanted us to hear it.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Which brings me to my next point. I also have a theory about our encounter with the Conqueror of Demons earlier.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I submit that we didn't actually see the Conqueror of Demons, he was somewhere else — but his status was transmitted to us through some kind of mind-bending spatial alteration.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: #Traveler, you said you saw the Abyss in that room, didn't you, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: At first glance, that door may seem like a prank. It shows you whatever you're afraid of. But if it manages to lure you inside...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: ...There's no way of knowing what might be in there. One minute, it's playing a joke to get you to lower your guard, the next, the danger is real, and it's trapped you.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: This space is a powerful opponent. It wants to use our minds against us.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: But I'm not gonna sit here and do nothing. Do you remember that small spatial rift next to the dissolving ground?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: It felt like spatial magic, but it seemed much more powerful than usual.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: When we saw that illusion of the Conqueror of Demons, it seemed like he wasn't expecting our spaces to intersect at all, and was even more surprised that we could hear and see him.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I think that this space purposely transmitted the Conqueror of Demons' voice to lure us into a trap...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: But I also think it didn't count on that spatial rift happening. In other words, the fact that we saw and spoke with the Conqueror of Demons was never part of its plan.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's why we were interrupted?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Yes. Also, I had a good look around after coming back. I have a feeling that these chaotic spaces are constantly intersecting with each other, meaning that anything is possible...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I think this gives us an opportunity. If the space creates phenomena meant to deceive us based on our imaginations, then we have to keep imagining, Traveler.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: If we try to stay calm and listen carefully... Maybe, just maybe, we'll hear the Conqueror of Demons' voice again.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Can you feel that? Let me see... I think it's here.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: ...And break!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Phew! I secretly learned Yelan's illusion-breaking method without her knowing. Haha, really didn't expect that to work.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: The sound came from behind this illusion. Let's go in and take a look.

choices.text: So that was a spatial rift.
He didn't really go the same way as us.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Are you alright? You've suddenly gone quiet. It's not like you at all.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Shh, we'll talk later. I'm just processing all the existing clues we have.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Maybe the key to our escape is hidden in some detail I've overlooked... I have to go over everything again...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Alright, well...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry. I won't write down anything that you told us about.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No, I meant, if you're going to analyze the facts, count me in.

talks.objective: Try to make contact with Xiao

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Xiao's eyes are tightly shut and he's not making a sound. No one has the heart to interrupt him.)

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: If we try to stay calm and listen carefully... Maybe, just maybe, we'll hear the Conqueror of Demons' voice again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Xiao has closed his eyes and seems to be resting... Could he be dreaming? This is quite astonishing.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Is a yaksha who never lowers his guard capable of having dreams?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... what's going on? Paimon's sense of direction is going haywire...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Stay alert. This is clearly no ordinary space.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: What an unusual place... Could it be some sort of adepti domain?
